# 🚀 [ShakeBest] - Official Modrinth Page

Are you ready to elevate your Minecraft experience? [ShakeBest] is a carefully crafted [Modpack / Resource Pack / Plugin] designed to deliver top-tier performance, aesthetics, and gameplay features all in one place.

This project aims to enhance the vanilla atmosphere of Minecraft while keeping the gameplay smooth, immersive, and highly enjoyable.

---

## ✨ Key Features

*   **⚡ Maximum Performance (FPS Friendly):** Optimized down to the last file. No bloatware or unnecessary heavy files, ensuring high FPS and smooth gameplay even on low-end systems.
*   **🎨 Enhanced Visuals:** [Eğer Resource Pack ise: Custom textures, animated items, and breathtaking sky details...] / [Eğer Mod paketi ise: Perfectly compatible visual mods...] that will make you fall in love with Minecraft all over again.
*   **🛠️ Zero Conflict & High Stability:** All components have been thoroughly tested for hours to ensure zero crashes, bugs, or compatibility issues.
*   **🎮 Multiplayer Ready:** Fully compatible with both your Singleplayer worlds and Multiplayer servers. Enjoy it flawlessly with your friends!

---

## 🛠️ Installation Guide

Follow these simple steps to install the project without any issues:

1.  Download the latest version of the project from Modrinth.
2.  Make sure your Minecraft version is set to **[Örn: 1.20.1]**.
3.  [Eğer Resource pack ise: "Go to Options > Resource Packs and move the pack to the selected side."]
